messages.subject: [IT] Document management system maintenance — Sunday 16 Nov
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear colleague,

The firm's document management system (FileSite) will be unavailable this Sunday 16 November between 06:00 and 10:00 for scheduled maintenance and a security patch. Please save and check in any open documents before Friday evening. Email and calendar are unaffected.

If you have any questions, raise a ticket on the IT portal.

IT Helpdesk
Whitfield Carter LLP
